available.quote: The board is authorized, at its discretion, to waive the examination requirements and issue a license or grant an authority to an applicant who is licensed under the laws of another state, a United States territory, a foreign nation or a foreign administrative division that issues licenses in the dental professions who furnishes proof, satisfactory to the board, that the requirements for licensure under this chapter have been met.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in good standing in another jurisdiction. definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the scope of practice for a dentist as described in section 18371.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the scope of practice for a dentist as described in section 18371.

value: Perform dental operations, oral surgery, or dental service of any kind
Obtain impressions of human teeth or jaws
Supply artificial substitutes for natural teeth; construct, reproduce or repair prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances or structures
Place dental appliances or structures in the human mouth and adjust them
Diagnose, prescribe for and treat disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of human teeth, jaws or adjacent structures
Extract human teeth
Correct malformations of teeth and jaws
Repair or fill cavities in human teeth
Diagnose malposed teeth and make and adjust appliances
Use x-ray machine for dental x-rays and interpret dental x-rays
Use title of dentist, dental surgeon or oral surgeon and letters D.D.S. or D.M.D.
Prescribe drugs or medicine; administer local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation; administer sedation and general anesthesia with appropriate permit
Take case histories and perform physical examinations as necessary in dental treatment
Administer botulinum toxin or dermal fillers when part of dental treatment plan
